Because neither a clear INCLUDE nor a clear EXCLUDE signal is present, recording the row per the brief's uncertain-case instruction with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than silently dropping it or confidently labeling it Clearance. qty was cross-validated by enumeration + HTML despite the ambiguity on inclusion, so the count itself (32) is not in doubt, only the Sale-vs-Clearance classification.
